notes.title: v1.02 Patch (Steam Overlay mostly)
notes.notes:
Another day, another patch.

- You can now resize the window with mouse. No more fullscreen prompt on launch, but screen size options in the menu bar. Alt+Enter can still be used to toggle.
- Fixed Shift+Tab for Steam overlay, can now take screenshots and such

notes.title: Now with a manual!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we know there's been a lot of questions and such about how the game works, so we've translated and released a game manual for everyone to look through. Check it out here:

https://sekaiproject.com/products/cherry-tree-high-girls-fight/#game-manual

We're open to hearing suggestions for other resources as well, just drop us a line in the discussion forums.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25146778/9d7d068d97b8a7172c234cc14ab0fad974dec15a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update ver. 1.01 - Fullscreen Option
notes.notes:
Added the following functionality:

- On first time startup, game prompt for fullscreen mode.
- Anytime fullscreen toggle with Alt+Enter.

That's all for today! Let's all have a good, clean fight!
